shortDescription: French defence company Exosens EURONEXT:EXENS raised its 2026 targets for revenue and core profit on Thursday, driven by a faster-than-expected ramp-up in production capacity and strong demand for its imaging technologies.The night-vision systems maker now expects annual revenue of between €558 mil…

children: raised its 2026 targets for revenue and core profit on Thursday, driven by a faster-than-expected ramp-up in production capacity and strong demand for its imaging technologies.

The night-vision systems maker now expects annual revenue of between €558 million and €570 million ($640 million and $653 million), and adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation of €186 million to €192 million.
